name: Toast stack
summary: Short notices that stack in a corner: done with an undo, in progress with a bar, and failed with a retry that keeps the person's work.
use: for short confirmations and background progress
a11y: Success and progress are status regions and the error is an alert; dismiss buttons have names; the entry motion uses the engine's toast tokens, which turn off under reduced motion.

use_when: after an action that can be undone for a few seconds, or a background upload or send the person should not wait on
avoid_when: a problem the person must deal with before going on: use alert-banners or confirm-dialog
a list of past notifications to read later: use notification-inbox
an error tied to one form field: show it under the field, as in sign-in-form

parts.name: toasts
parts.what: one notice: an icon for done, busy or failed, a message, actions and dismiss

parts.name: message
parts.what: the main line in bold weight

parts.name: detail
parts.what: a short second line with the detail

parts.name: progress
parts.what: a thin bar under a busy notice

parts.name: action
parts.what: one text action such as Undo, Cancel or Retry

parts.name: dismiss
parts.what: icon button that removes the notice

empty.how: when the last notice is dismissed the list is left empty; remove the list or keep it as an empty live region so new notices are announced

loading.how: a busy notice shows what is running, how far it has got and a thin progress bar

error.how: a failed notice is an alert with a danger icon, says the work is kept and offers Retry

disabled.how: after Undo or Retry is pressed, set disabled on that button until the result comes back

overflow.how: the stack grows with each notice; keep at most three and drop the oldest done notice first

long_text.how: the message column can shrink and wrap; on a narrow screen the actions move under the text

keyboard: Tab reaches each notice's action button and dismiss button
Enter or Space on Dismiss removes the notice and moves focus to a button in the next or previous notice
Undo, Cancel and Retry are buttons with no behaviour wired in the file
